description: Public Dataset | HDOT Highway Revenues | act100 highway fund sources 2018-2020 | STATIC 2020 is a dataset listed in Hawaii Department of Transportation open data portal (highways.hidot.hawaii.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Hawaii Department of Transportation. This is a static dataset and provides a breakdown of HDOT Highways revenues. The dataset provides the breakdown of fund sources for 2018, 2019, and 2020. As mentioned, this dataset is static and will not update as the performance year has closed. Coverage: Hawaii. The portal files it under the category Act100. The table has 3 columns. The portal shows 2021-01-06 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-highways-hidot-hawaii-gov-portal.
